items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: He played clarinet with Oliver. I mean, in the section, you know, Barney and Albert Nicholas and Darnell Howard, you know.

ctx.x: Did he ever play clarinet at all with Oliver?

Yeah, yeah. He played clarinet with Oliver. I mean, in the section, you know, Barney and Albert Nicholas and Darnell Howard, you know. Yeah. But Albert was the best clarinet player, I mean, at that time, at that particular time.
Well, so did Oliver feature on clarinet mostly?
